Name: Clint is a Viking Portrait mod mod
Author: DanielNeevo
Description:
I tried to modify the portraits of another portrait mod a bit, and ended up getting the idea to change Clint the Blacksmith into a Viking. Based on a pre-existing portrait mod by 浪里小红花, simply search the name into google and you'll find it.

A few references thrown in here and there. And yes, I know the bevor is not a Viking thing. Just looks cool.

His ambiguously coloured cola is not lore-friendly. Neither is the armour I suppose.

Downloads.Description: The file to replace Clint's xnb under 'portraits'

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
